headline: Microsoft Clarity: See how people use your website 🧐
body: Watch session recordings and heatmaps to understand user behavior. Pinpoint what works and what needs improving on your pages.
caption:
Ever wondered where visitors click or scroll on your website? Microsoft Clarity offers free tools like heatmaps and session recordings to give you visual insights. It's a fantastic way to spot tricky spots or popular areas, helping you make small, practical improvements. Remember, free plans can change, so check Clarity's website for the latest limits and features!
